userStories.title: Add adaptive parallel fetch worker count based on batch size
acceptanceCriteria: Implement worker count calculation: scale workers based on batch size (more workers for larger batches)

Add rate limit feedback loop: reduce workers when rate limit errors increase
Log worker count decisions at INFO: strategy_used, calculated_count, batch_size
Add worker_count to CaptionMetrics for correlation analysis with success rate
userStories.notes: Implemented: 1) Added worker_count_strategy config ('static', 'adaptive', 'cpu_count') in CaptionFirstConfig, 2) Added min_workers (4), max_workers_limit (8), batch_size_threshold (100), 3) Adaptive scaling in caption_stage.py - linear interpolation from min to max based on batch size, 4) Rate limit feedback loop - reduces workers when rate limit errors exceed threshold (15%), 5) Logs worker count decisions at INFO with strategy_used, calculated_count, batch_size, 6) Added worker_count and worker_count_strategy fields to CaptionMetrics for correlation analysis.
